name: Kurt Gemoya
headline: BSIT student building dashboards, data pipelines and AI backends that real people use.
bio: I work across data analytics, AI engineering and cloud development. Across two internships I have built automated dashboards, Python data pipelines, backend services and cloud-deployed models, and I validate them on held-out data and with real users.

I'm studying BS Information Technology at the Polytechnic University of the Philippines (expected June 2028, GPA 1.42, President's Lister ×3) and lead the Data Science and Analytics Department of the AWS Student Builder Group PUP Manila.
contactNote: I'm looking for an internship where I can apply data, AI and engineering skills to real problems.
